verdict.rationale: No native webhooks are documented. The developer page only says mail can be connected to 5000+ apps via Zapier, which implies event-driven triggers through a third-party tool, and that an API exists for workflow control. The API has no published spec (the OpenAPI and docs probes returned 404). Missing for 10: documented native webhook subscriptions, a list of event types (e.g. new mail received, scan completed, check deposited), payload and signature docs, delivery and retry semantics, a published API reference, and independent corroboration.
